import json, os
def shp(g):
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    # split top vs bottom by row<5
    return cells
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find divider row of 5s
    div=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==5 for x in g[r])][0]
    top=g[:div]; bot=g[div+1:]
    # bottom shape
    bc=[(r,c) for r in range(len(bot)) for c in range(W) if bot[r][c]!=0]
    col=bot[bc[0][0]][bc[0][1]]
    bcellcol={c for r,c in bc}
    c0,c1=min(bcellcol),max(bcellcol); bcen=(c0+c1)/2
    # top shapes: connected components by color
    from collections import deque
    seen=set(); shapes=[]
    for r in range(len(top)):
        for c in range(W):
            if top[r][c]!=0 and (r,c) not in seen:
                colr=top[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    rr,cc=q.popleft(); cells.append((rr,cc))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                        if 0<=nr<len(top) and 0<=nc<W and (nr,nc) not in seen and top[nr][nc]==colr:
                            seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
                shapes.append((colr,cells))
    def symmetric(cells):
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)

    for r in range(len(top)):

            if top[r][c]!=0 and (r,c) not in seen:
                colr=top[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while q:
                    rr,cc=q.popleft(); cells.append((rr,cc))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
